run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T16:15:27Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning on otel-demo/frontend is explained by failures on the frontend's checkout path only. From 16:15:27 onward, frontend records error spans solely on POST, POST /api/checkout, its internal route span 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout', its client span 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and 'tcp.connect'; every other frontend operation stayed error-free. In the same period the checkout service stopped emitting spans entirely (5-minute span increase fell from 2991 at 16:14:27 to 871 at 16:18:27 and 0 from 16:20:27 onward), and its only pod, checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q, is in CrashLoopBackOff (NotReady, 11 restarts, last termination exit code 2, reason Error), so the checkout Service has no ready endpoints. The pod's own container definition now points at gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest for both the checkout container and the wait-for-kafka init container, while the owning Deployment checkout still specifies ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout and busybox:latest and is still at generation/observedGeneration 1; a kubelet event 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' was recorded at 16:17:20 and the pause image was pulled for this pod. Sibling pods still run their demo images, and payment, currency, email, shipping, kafka, cart, product-catalog, ad, recommendation, accounting and the frontend pod itself show no own failures. What produced the exit-code-2 crash and who changed the container definition could not be read, so the deepest step of the chain remains unverified.

claims.text: frontend error spans are confined to the checkout path: the 2-minute error rate per operation is 0 for GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart across 15:51:27-16:25:27, while POST /api/checkout, POST, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder rise from 0 at 16:13:27 to 0.167/s at 16:15:27, 0.778/s at 16:17:27, 0.501/s at 16:19:27, 1.0/s at 16:21:27, 0.8/s at 16:23:27 and 0.978/s at 16:25:27, and tcp.connect errors appear from 16:15:27 at 0.078/s and remain intermittent.

At the end of the alert window the 15-minute error-span counts for service_name=frontend are 305.04 on POST, 305.04 on POST /api/checkout, 305.04 on executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, 305.04 on grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and 18.07 on tcp.connect, while GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart and grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct show 0 error spans.

The checkout service's own span volume collapsed: its 5-minute span increase was 2991.1 at 16:14:27, 2227.0 at 16:16:27, 871.1 at 16:18:27 and 0 at each point from 16:20:27 through 16:28:27; payment (444.4 at 16:14:27 to 0 at 16:24:27), currency, email and shipping fell to ~0 in the same interval after prior steady traffic, while frontend kept producing 15875-16834 spans per 5 minutes.

Pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q is phase Running but Ready=False and ContainersReady=False with reason ContainersNotReady since 16:21:20; its checkout container has restartCount 11 and is in state waiting/CrashLoopBackOff ('back-off 2m40s restarting failed container=checkout'), with lastState terminated startedAt 16:21:15, finishedAt 16:21:20, exitCode 2, reason Error. It has no liveness, readiness or startup probe and limits of cpu 250m / memory 512Mi (Burstable).

The running pod's container spec diverges from its owner's template: pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q lists image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest for the checkout container and for the wait-for-kafka init container, whereas Deployment checkout specifies image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout and init image busybox:latest, and the Deployment is still at generation 1, observedGeneration 1, revision 1.

For that same checkout container, containerStatuses report image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout with imageID ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:f000c1de37175546a22846714e1c11a19bc2997e8769bb7bffcab5c4c10c24b2, i.e. the recorded status image differs from the image currently in the pod spec.

Other otel-demo pods still carry their expected demo images: email-59f69bc6cf-zsfdz ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-email, frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-frontend, frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-c8ks2 ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-frontend-proxy, kafka-ff7884766-svvv8 ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-kafka and payment-55766d76b9-rlrgr ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment.

Kubernetes events for checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q within the window include 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' (reason Killing, count 7, lastTimestamp 2026-11-16T16:17:20Z), 'Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q_otel-demo' (reason BackOff, Warning, count 26, lastTimestamp 2026-11-16T16:22:08Z), and 'Container image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest" already present on machine' for the same pod.

The checkout Service has no ready endpoints: its EndpointSubset contains only notReadyAddresses for pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q (uid 6b803e7a-86b0-47d4-b95d-e4c9bee17da2, ip 100.96.4.26) on port 8080.

frontend-proxy recorded error spans on 'ingress' (419.8 per 15 minutes) and 'router frontend egress' (415.7 per 15 minutes) in the same end-of-window period, alongside frontend's checkout-path errors.

Before the failure, checkout was processing orders normally: its container log lines from 16:00:01 to 16:00:29 show repeated '[PlaceOrder]', 'payment went through', 'order placed', 'order confirmation email sent to ...' and 'Successful to write message. offset: 0' Kafka writes.

Ownership chain confirmed: pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q is owned by ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb, and ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb is controlled by Deployment checkout; 21 pods exist in otel-demo and all others (accounting, ad, cart, currency, email, flagd, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, product-catalog, quote, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart) are Running/Ready with 0 restarts.

Most likely causal chain: the checkout pod's container definition was altered (kubelet event at 16:17:20, pause image in the pod spec and pulled for this pod), the checkout container cannot run and repeatedly exits with code 2, the pod never becomes Ready, the checkout Service ends up with only notReady addresses, and frontend's POST /api/checkout -> grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder calls fail, producing the frontend error spans that trigger RequestErrorRate.

Alternative remaining explanation for the checkout crash: an application-level startup failure inside the checkout container itself (exit code 2 is compatible with a Go panic) rather than the image/definition change; the crash output could not be read, so this cannot be separated from the container-definition hypothesis.

frontend-proxy's ingress and 'router frontend egress' error spans are propagation of frontend's failing checkout responses (500s), not an independent frontend-proxy fault; frontend-proxy's own pod is Running/Ready with 0 restarts.

Kafka unavailability as the cause is not supported: kafka-ff7884766-svvv8 is Running/Ready with 0 restarts, and checkout's last log lines before the failure show successful Kafka writes ('Successful to write message. offset: 0') plus successful payment and email steps.

A fault in the frontend pod itself is not supported: frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg is Running/Ready with 0 restarts, and frontend emits error spans only on its checkout-related operations while all its other operations stay at zero errors.

Failures in the checkout downstream dependencies are not supported: payment, currency, email and shipping pods are Running/Ready with 0 restarts, payment and currency error-span series read 0 (payment GET/dns.lookup/tcp.connect 0, currency Currency/Convert STATUS_CODE_OK), and their traffic stopped only after checkout stopped producing spans.

The incident is localized to one workload: 20 of 21 otel-demo pods are Running/Ready with 0 restarts, and the only low-level steady error signals elsewhere are flagd EventStream/ResolveBoolean errors on ad, fraud-detection and recommendation held at ~1.04-1.06 per 15 minutes in each of the four end-of-window points, i.e. a flat baseline rather than a new burst tied to the checkout path.

Recreate the checkout pod from its unchanged Deployment template (for example delete pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q or restart Deployment checkout) so a pod with the ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout image replaces the pause-image pod, then verify pod readiness, the checkout Service endpoint becoming ready, and frontend POST /api/checkout error spans returning to zero.

gaps: The checkout container's crash output could not be read: fetch_pod_logs reports the previous checkout instance as unavailable, and no log lines exist for the pod between 16:20:00 and 16:33:26; the reason for exit code 2 is therefore unverified.

Who or what changed the container definition of pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q around 16:15-16:17 is unknown; the change_history integration is not available in this Run and no Kubernetes audit information was accessible.

kube-state-metrics series were unavailable: kube_pod_container_info{namespace="otel-demo"} and kube_deployment_status_replicas_available/ready{deployment="checkout"} returned no data, so deployment-level availability history for checkout is unknown and current live objects were used instead.

Jaeger's retained traces end at about 16:08 (checkout trace query returned spans sourced 16:08:09-16:08:22), and traces_search/traces_search_by_tags for frontend over 16:15-16:33 returned no data, so no span-level error detail (for example the exact gRPC error) is available for the 16:15+ failure window.

No rule named RequestErrorRate was found via list_prometheus_rules, so the alert's exact expression, evaluation interval and the meaning of the value 3.4999999999999996 could not be verified from Prometheus; the alert labels were used only as leads.

It could not be verified whether the pause image in the pod spec was introduced after the last container start, although the container status still reports the demo:2.1.3-checkout image; the order of those two states is unknown.
next_steps: Inspect the pod with kubectl describe/get -o yaml and try kubectl logs --previous for the checkout container while the crashed instance is still retained, to capture the exit-code-2 diagnostic output.

Check Kubernetes audit logs or the platform change log for a pod patch or exec affecting checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q between 16:15:00Z and 16:17:20Z, since the Deployment itself was not rolled (generation 1).
Confirm the alert clears once checkout has a Ready endpoint, and keep monitoring frontend POST /api/checkout error spans during recovery.
